title: Rehabilitation unit.
bodyText: There is established within the department of labor and industrial relations a rehabilitation unit. All professional and clerical employees of this unit shall be appointed and administered by the director. The rehabilitation unit shall have the duties and responsibilities provided in section 386-25. Employees of the unit shall be subject to chapter 76.
bodyHtml: §386-71.5  Rehabilitation unit.  There is established within the department of labor and industrial relations a rehabilitation unit.  All professional and clerical employees of this unit shall be appointed and administered by the director.  The rehabilitation unit shall have the duties and responsibilities provided in section 386-25.  Employees of the unit shall be subject to chapter 76. [L 1980, c 224, §1; am L 2000, c 253, §150; am L 2018, c 188, §2]
